data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin words 'odos' meaning 'wealth' and 'linos' meaning 'grace'. This name was popular among early Christians and signified a person who was rich in God's grace. The name Odelinda carries the meaning “Wealthy in grace” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Odelinda usually hope their child will grow to embody wealthy in grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Οδελινδη

in_latin.name: Odelinda
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Odelinda is derived from the Latin words 'ode' (weaker) and 'linde' (to God). Therefore, the name Odelinda in Latin means 'Weaker to God'.

in_english.name: Odelinda
in_english.long_meaning: The English name Odelinda is derived from the Hebrew word 'adel' (God's refuge).
